answer: Operator, 2026-11-05: a tiny harness-specific plugin, extension or hook per harness, starting with pi. d-harness-state records it.
body: Nothing writes it, and without it `blocked` stays a documented value with no producer. Options: an upstream PR to zmx_attach, a small local pi extension beside pi-zmx, or leave it for after v0.1. Recommendation: upstream PR after the release, since it needs no fork and does not gate anything.
title: Who writes state=blocked?
